about.title: About us
about.lead: Tres Ceibas is a community in Villa Magante, Dominican Republic, with many of its sons and daughters living abroad.
story: Tres Ceibas is a rural community of families who have known each other all their lives. We grew up playing on the court, going to church and celebrating every festivity together.
Over time, many of our children moved abroad, but they never stopped feeling like ceiberos. Every visit, every call and every contribution from afar keeps the bond with home alive.
Today we are organizing to give the community something it lacks: a place of its own where young people and families can gather in a healthy environment.

about.mission: To strengthen community ties through cultural, religious and sports activities in Tres Ceibas.

goals.title: Cultural identity
goals.body: Keep our traditions alive with typical music, dance, local crafts and the food fair.

goals.title: Sports
goals.body: Encourage sports with basketball tournaments, track events, walks and games for kids.

goals.title: Youth
goals.body: Bring young people into healthy activities that build peaceful coexistence.

goals.title: Faith and values
goals.body: Nurture spiritual values together with our church, with a community mass and moments of unity.

about.dreamBody: Today we have no recreation spaces of our own. That is why we are raising funds to buy the land for the Tres Ceibas community club: a place for sports, culture, family gatherings and celebrations for the whole community.
dreamPoints: A safe space for kids and teens
A meeting place for those who come home from abroad
about.committeeLead: Volunteer neighbors who organize the activities and report back to the community.
about.transparencyBody: Every donation is recorded and added to the total you see on the site. Contributions are used only for the purposes described in each project, all of them non-profit.
transparencyPoints: Every online gift is recorded instantly and shown on the donor wall, with your name or anonymously.
The donor covers the card fee, so the project receives the full amount.
Cash and bank transfers are recorded by the committee and also count toward the total.
Each project shows how the money will be used, line by line.
